Good Idea!!?? GOOD IDEA!!!???

cues.en: Not a good idea? Political suicide!

cues.en: an administrative matter and the prime minister agreed.

cues.en: isn't it? Yes and no, if you forgive the expression.

cues.en: The Foreign Office is pro-Europe because it is really anti-Europe.

cues.en: The Civil Service was united in it's desire to make sure the Common Market didn't work.

cues.en: No that we're inside we can make a complete pig's breakfast of the whole thing!

cues.en: Set the Germans against the French, the French against the Italians, the Italians against

cues.en: Well, for the same reason. It's just like the United Nations in fact.

cues.en: The more members it has, the more arguments it can stir up.

cues.zh: 它就越无用、越无力。令人震惊的玩世不恭……
